en: All henchmen of da boss - Stomper Kreeg, all three of da Guards, Captain Kromcrush, and da Observer - give tribute to da new boss.  If you kill a henchman, then that henchman can't give tribute!  Each one you keep alive will give you more tribute.  Keep all of them alive and you get da BIG tribute!$B$BYeah!
Ah, I can sense it - you've won the day! I believe I can safely transport you to Stratholme now, provided you've paid my colleague there a visit first. Just step into the circle and be patient...

You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and shall become a great priestess of our goddess Elune. Her grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
Welcome to my shop, it's good to see another Enchanter here in Stormwind. Are you here for a lesson perhaps?
Welcome to Tanaris, $n. How can I be of service to you today? You don't look like a blacksmith to me, but I know how looks can be deceiving.
The rebels of Lordaeron are small and weak, and know not the joy of serving our Lich King.
Hrm, I'm listening. What is this offer?
The forest is crawling with worgen and ghouls.  Something must be done!
Right away, master!
Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us $g sir : ma'am;?
I spent my whole life caring for these trees. Pruning and nurturing them... only fitting that they have joined me in death.

Zug zug, my friend!  I am Kelm Hargunth, the main supplier for the Warsong Outriders.  As you improve your standing with the Outriders, I will make available to you a fine selection of goods that you can use inside Warsong Gulch.  Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.
%s's strength dwindles as chunks of rock break off
Is Tanaris currently under attack?
I need directions.

Such needless strife, but if the elves of Silverwing Hold will not speak to us in peace, then what alternative do they leave us? Seek out the aid of Kergul Bloodaxe on the Hunter Rise to get to Warsong Gulch.
The Stormpike Guard must be destroyed!  Ready for Alterac Valley $c?
There are fundamental things you must learn before I can aid you. Speak to my apprentice, Vhan. He is kind and patient and will teach you what you need to know.
Markhor, I wish to stable my pet.

Master Woo Ping has mastered nearly every weapon known to man.  He is especially deadly with his sword techniques.  He spends a good deal of time over in the Weller's Arsenal waiting on new shipments of weapons to arrive if you need some training.
Come one! Come all! Perelli's elixirs will dazzle!
So you would like to learn a few things? I would be happy to get you started!
Through the second turn it's the $n!
You dare interrupt our prayer? Execute them!
May the Deadmines serve as your tomb, $n!
You'll rue the day you crossed me, $n.
Back away!  Stay back!  I have a pack full of blastpowder and I'm not afraid to use it!  I'll blow us all away!$B$BOh, never mind.  I thought you were someone else....
A pleasure, $n. What can I do for you?

As I understand it dear, everything has been gathered and the final materiel is being assembled and shipped off to Cenarion Hold. The last of it should arrive in less than a day. Once our equipment and forces are all there, the bearer of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands can ring the gong near Ahn'Qiraj to open the gates. Then the war will begin.
The Stormpike Aid Station is in Dun Baldar, right outside the Dun Baldar barracks.$B$BNeither side currently controls it.
Easier than I expected... the sigil of Thoradin is whole, once again.
Greetings, $c!  Welcome to the Cathedral of Light!
Here comes the postmaster!
You are da king of the Gordok!  You're A-number-one!
The best miner has a firm grip on $ghis:her; pick, a stout heart in $ghis:her; chest, and thick, black dust in $ghis:her; hair.
Take care, and send our regards to your family.
Open for business! The goblin car is looking sharp and it's sure to be a winner! Get your bets in before the race starts!
Ugh! What is that scoundrel doing sending his vermin to me? Get out of my sight before I take what is left of your life. And take this with you.
Turn that frown upside down!

The only way a hero can die, $r: Through tragedy. The Grand Crusader struck a deal with Kel'Thuzad himself! An ambush would be staged that would result in the death of Mograine. The type of betrayal that could only be a result of the actions of one's most trusted and loved companions.

Aye, but I know it by its true name - Eldre'Thalas.  It was a bastion of magical power for the night elves many, many years ago.$B$BYou know of Eldre'Thalas, young one?  One might say that is coincidental to my current plight... but I am one not to believe in coincidence.
YOU WERE SUCH GOOD SPORT THE LAST TIME...COME OUT!
What little remained of Thunderaan's essence was stored within a talisman of elemental binding. Ragnaros then shattered the talisman in two flawless pieces. The pieces assigned to his Lieutenants...
